formats.name: Blender .blend
formats.core_joint_position: bone rotation and IK constraint fields
formats.custom: object / pose bone / data bone ID properties
formats.semantic: native enforced evaluation not same as stored input rotations; IK limits independent

formats.name: OpenUSD .usd/.usda
formats.core_joint_position: UsdPhysics joints and per-DOF limits/drives; not automatically UsdSkel
formats.custom: USD attribute namespace, customData, API schemas
formats.semantic: angular PhysicsRevolute limit degrees; distinct physics vs skeleton joint hierarchy; custom skeletal constraints plugin-specific

formats.name: FBX .fbx
formats.core_joint_position: FbxNode RotationActive, RotationMin/Max and per-axis switches
formats.semantic: axis/Euler order/pre/post rotation; exporter may lose active/enabled flags

formats.name: glTF .gltf/.glb
formats.core_joint_position: none for anatomical skeletal joint range in glTF core
formats.semantic: nodes+skins define animation and skinning; custom ROM metadata is not enforced by glTF renderer; roundtrip depends exporter

formats.name: OpenSim .osim
formats.core_joint_position: Coordinate range, clamped/locked and nonlinear CustomJoint coordinate transforms
formats.semantic: rotational ranges rad in XML, translational meters; source-specific physiological validity

formats.name: URDF .urdf
formats.core_joint_position: revolute/prismatic lower/upper, velocity, effort, mimic; continuous no position limits
formats.semantic: URDF topology tree, no intrinsic multi-DOF coupled anatomical limits; hardware controller separate

formats.name: MuJoCo MJCF .xml
formats.core_joint_position: joint range/limited, joint and actuator force/damping and equality/tendon dynamics
formats.semantic: compiler angular units explicit; actuator effort not equivalent to a simple joint hard limit

formats.name: VTK .vtp/.vtu
formats.core_joint_position: no common interoperable joint rig ROM schema
formats.custom: point,cell,field data arrays and external metadata
formats.semantic: geometry/data container not a portable skeletal constraint format
